entries.description: the Buddha was staying in a forest near Icchānaṅgala
entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: staying in a forest near Icchānaṅgala

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying in a forest near Icchānaṅgala.

entries.description: They’ve cut the strap and harness
entries.subject: They’ve

spans.text: Usabhaṁ pavaraṁ vīraṁ, Captain of the herd, excellent hero, Chetvā naddhiṁ varattañca, They’ve cut the strap and harness, mahesiṁ vijitāvinaṁ; great seer and victor; Anejaṁ nhātakaṁ buddhaṁ, unstirred, washed, awakened: tamahaṁ brūmi brāhmaṇaṁ.
Pubbenivāsaṁ yo vedi, They who know their past lives, saggāpāyañca passati; see heaven and places of loss, Atho jātikkhayaṁ patto, and have attained the end of rebirth: tamahaṁ brūmi brāhmaṇaṁ.

Yo dukkhassa pajānāti, They understand for themselves idheva khayamattano; the end of suffering in this life; Pannabhāraṁ visaṁyuttaṁ, with burden put down, detached: Bhovādi nāma so hoti, If they still have attachments, tamahaṁ brūmi brāhmaṇaṁ.

entries.description: and what is not the path
entries.subject: and what

spans.text: Gambhīrapaññaṁ medhāviṁ, Deep in wisdom, intelligent, maggāmaggassa kovidaṁ; expert in the path and what is not the path; Uttamatthamanuppattaṁ, arrived at the highest goal: tamahaṁ brūmi brāhmaṇaṁ.
Akakkasaṁ viññāpaniṁ, The words they utter giraṁ saccaṁ udīraye; are polished, informative, and true, Yāya nābhisajje kiñci, and don’t offend anyone: tamahaṁ brūmi brāhmaṇaṁ.
